title: Anya Taylor-Joy Was Speechless Meeting Gandalf on Set
excerpt:
The Hunt for Gollum newcomer recalled meeting Ian McKellen.
She had wanted to join the franchise since working on Dune.
body_md:
Anya Taylor-Joy recalled her first encounter with Ian McKellen in costume as Gandalf during a Dazed interview about The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum. The actress was so overwhelmed that she briefly became speechless, despite finding McKellen warm, funny and extraordinarily talented.

Taylor-Joy plays an elf named Seren. While working on Dune, she had already asked her agent to communicate her interest if another Lord of the Rings film entered development.

She previously explained that, as a child, she mistakenly thought she had to choose between Harry Potter and The Lord of the Rings. Watching the latter films during the pandemic changed her mind. In July 2026, she said she was preparing to read Tolkien's books.

Andy Serkis directs the new film while reprising Gollum. Elijah Wood and Lee Pace return as Frodo and Thranduil, while Kate Winslet and Leo Woodall portray Marigol and Halvard. Jamie Dornan takes over the role of Aragorn from Viggo Mortensen.

Before The Hunt for Gollum reaches theaters in December 2027, Taylor-Joy will return as Alia Atreides in Denis Villeneuve's final Dune film, scheduled for December 18, 2026.
